# NEW 2026-11-21 v8.5 Three Civilizations Cross-Era Military Evolution System (oe_mil_, slot 66). Generated by gen_military_evolution.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Initialization & Sync
oe_mil_ensure_init = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_init } }
        set_global_variable = oe_mil_init
        set_global_variable = oe_mil_on
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_m value = oe_mil_now_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_sent_cnt value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_byz_reformed value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_yuan_reformed value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_rus_reformed value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_silk_exchanged value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_1 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_2 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_3 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_4 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_5 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_6 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_7 value = 0 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_8 value = 0 }
    }
}

# Country scope. Syncs v8.0 upstream flags and strips Firepower Gap once firearm reform is done.
oe_mil_sync_country_state = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_mil_is_byz_unit_host = yes oe_mil_byz_v80_reformed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_mil_byz_reformed value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_byz_reformed value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_mil_is_yuan_unit_host = yes oe_mil_yuan_v80_reformed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_mil_yuan_reformed value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_yuan_reformed value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_mil_is_rus_unit_host = yes oe_mil_rus_v80_reformed = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_mil_rus_reformed value = 1 }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_rus_reformed value = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_country_modifier = oe_mil_firepower_gap
            NOT = { oe_mil_needs_age5_modernization = yes }
        }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_mil_firepower_gap
    }
}

# Country scope. Per-protagonist monthly evolution dispatch (1 event max per call).
oe_mil_tick_byz = {
    oe_mil_sync_country_state = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_mil_age_4_plus = yes
            has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_1
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_1 } global_var:oe_mil_st_1 = 0 }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_1 value = 1 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_sent_cnt add = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mil.1
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_mil_age_5_plus = yes
            has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_2
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_2 } global_var:oe_mil_st_2 = 0 }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_st_2 value = 1 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_sent_cnt add = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mil.2
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_mil_age_4_plus = yes
            oe_mil_silk_road_active = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_mil_silk_sent }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_mil_silk_sent value = 1 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_sent_cnt add = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mil.8
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            oe_mil_needs_age5_modernization = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_mil_gap_warned }
            has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_2
            trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_2 } global_var:oe_mil_st_2 >= 1 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_mil_gap_warned value = 1 }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_sent_cnt add = 1 }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_mil.7
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Slot 66 Monthly Scheduler Entry (idempotent per month)
oe_mil_monthly = {
    oe_mil_ensure_init = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_ran_m }
                AND = {
                    has_global_variable = oe_mil_ran_m
                    trigger_if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_ran_m } global_var:oe_mil_ran_m != oe_mil_now_m }
                }
            }
        }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_ran_m value = oe_mil_now_m }
        set_global_variable = { name = oe_mil_m value = oe_mil_now_m }

        # 1. Byzantium / Rome
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:ROM }
            c:ROM = { if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_mil_tick_byz = yes } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:BYZ }
            c:BYZ = { if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_mil_tick_byz = yes } }
        }

        # 2. Restored Great Yuan (CHI)
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:CHI oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes }
            c:CHI = { if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_mil_tick_yuan = yes } }
        }

        # 3. Rus' / Tsardom of Russia (RUS -> MOS -> NOV -> KIE)
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:RUS }
            c:RUS = { if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_mil_tick_rus = yes } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:MOS }
            c:MOS = { if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_mil_tick_rus = yes } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:NOV }
            c:NOV = { if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_mil_tick_rus = yes } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:KIE }
            c:KIE = { if = { limit = { is_rebel_country = no } oe_mil_tick_rus = yes } }
        }
    }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Test Helpers (DEV_LINES mil* for Page 65)
oe_mil_test_start = {
    oe_mil_ensure_init = yes
    set_global_variable = oe_mil_on
}

oe_mil_test_month = {
    oe_mil_ensure_init = yes
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_ran_m } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_ran_m }
    oe_mil_monthly = yes
}

oe_mil_test_clear = {
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_init } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_init }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_on } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_on }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_m } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_ran_m } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_ran_m }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_sent_cnt } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_sent_cnt }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_byz_reformed } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_byz_reformed }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_yuan_reformed } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_yuan_reformed }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_rus_reformed } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_rus_reformed }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_silk_exchanged } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_silk_exchanged }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_1 } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_st_1 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_2 } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_st_2 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_3 } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_st_3 }

    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_7 } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_st_7 }
    if = { limit = { has_global_variable = oe_mil_st_8 } remove_global_variable = oe_mil_st_8 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_mil_job } remove_variable = oe_mil_job }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_mil_byz_reformed } remove_variable = oe_mil_byz_reformed }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_mil_dec_byz_cd } remove_variable = oe_mil_dec_byz_cd }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_mil_dec_yuan_cd } remove_variable = oe_mil_dec_yuan_cd }

        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mil_byz_pike_doctrine } remove_country_modifier = oe_mil_byz_pike_doctrine }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_mil_byz_siphon_doctrine } remove_country_modifier = oe_mil_byz_siphon_doctrine }
